In this vignette, we make all the gene expression plots shown in the various main and supplemental figures of the paper. 

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggpubr)

s1 = 2# size for points in PCA plot
legend_pt_size =4
plot_title_size = 25
axis_text_size = 25
axis_title_size=25
legend_text_size=25
plot_text = 10
spacing=1
chosen_margin = c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5)# margins:top,right,bottom,left
theme_clean <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(hjust=0, vjust=0, 
                                  lineheight=.8, face="bold", size=plot_title_size ),
        plot.margin=unit(chosen_margin,"cm"), 
        legend.text=element_text(size=legend_text_size),
        legend.key.height = unit(spacing, "cm"),
        #legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.2) ,
        legend.title=element_blank() , 
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        axis.text.x=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x=element_blank(), 
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank())


myPalette <- colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdYlBu"))) # for gene expression
my_gene_fun = function(goi){
    goi = intersect(goi, rownames(gene_exp_file))    
    l1 = lapply(goi, function(my_goi){
        message(my_goi)
        mat= umap_data2
        mat$gene_exp = unlist(gene_exp_file[ match(my_goi, rownames(gene_exp_file)), ])              
        mat = mat[ order(mat$gene_exp, decreasing=FALSE), ]
        ylim = max(mat$gene_exp)
        ylow = min(mat$gene_exp )
        sc <- scale_colour_gradientn(colours = myPalette(ylim), limits=c(ylow, ylim))        
        fig1 =  ggplot(mat, aes(PaCMAP1, PaCMAP2, color=gene_exp )) +
            geom_point(size=2) + ggtitle(paste0( my_goi)) + 
            sc + theme_clean +  
            theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.3) )        
        fig1
    })
}

qual_col_pals = brewer.pal.info[brewer.pal.info$category == 'qual',]
col_vector = unlist(mapply(brewer.pal, qual_col_pals$maxcolors, rownames(qual_col_pals)))

setwd("~/HollandLabShared/Ramya/breast_landscape/Sonali_final_data/Objects")
resdir = "~/HollandLabShared/Ramya/Sonali_final_data/breast_landscape/breast_Figures"
umap_data2 = read.delim("final_metadata_5_21_2026.txt", header=T, stringsAsFactors=F)
gene_exp_file = readRDS("log2tpm_new_GSEs.rds")

identical( colnames(gene_exp_file) , umap_data2$sampleName)

## Fig 2: validation figure
markers = c(
    "KRT5",  "FOXC1", "SOX10", # basal / triple neg
    "STARD3", "GRB7", "PGAP3" ,# her2 
    "GATA3", "SPDEF", "FOXA1" ,# LUMINAL A
    "MKI67", "CCNB1", "AURKA" , 
    "ERBB2",  "ESR1", "PGR")

a1 = my_gene_fun(markers)
pdf(file.path( "../breast_Figures/Multiplot_suppFig2_Validation_gene_markers_8_5_2026.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
ggarrange( plotlist =  a1, nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()


## Fig 3 :
ERIC_KINASES  = c("PDGFD", "RET", "FGFR3", "MET", "KIT", "FGFR2" )
pdf(file.path( "../breast_Figures/Multiplot_Fig3_Eric_kinases_4_24_2026.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
a1 = my_gene_fun(ERIC_KINASES)
ggarrange( plotlist =  a1, nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()

## supp fig 3b 
chosen_kinases = c("PDK4", "PDGFRB", "TIE1", "TGFBR2",  # LUM a
                   "FGFR1","IGF1R",  "WNK4" , "HSPB8",  "MPP7",  "MAPK9", # lum B 
                   "AKT1" ,  "TTK")
pdf(file.path( "../breast_Figures/Multiplot_SUPP_Fig3_final_kinases_4_24_2026.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
a1 = my_gene_fun(chosen_kinases)
ggarrange( plotlist =  a1, nrow =4, ncol =3)
dev.off()

genes = c( "GATA3", "AGR2", "KRT8", "KRT18", "KRT19",
    "MUC1", "SPDEF", "TFF3", "SCUBE2",  "CA12", 
    "KRT14", "TP63")
pdf(file.path( "../breast_Figures/Multiplot_cluster_F_5_13_2026.pdf"), height = 20, width = 16)
a1 = my_gene_fun(genes)
ggarrange( plotlist =  a1, nrow =4, ncol =3)
```
